usageNotes: Use this to discover what backup namespaces exist within a specific PBS remote datastore, typically before scoping a snapshot browse or restore to a sub-namespace. The calling PDM user or token requires the Resource.Audit privilege on the remote/datastore path. Without the 'parent' filter the call returns all namespaces up to PBS's 8-level depth limit; use 'max-depth' to limit the tree when datastores are heavily nested.

examples.summary: List all namespaces under the 'clients' parent namespace in a remote datastore, limited to two levels deep

tips: An empty 'ns' string in the response represents the root namespace of the datastore.
The 'comment' field is optional and sourced from the first line of the namespace's notes — useful for labeling namespaces by client or environment.
Namespaces support up to 8 path segments; the pattern enforces alphanumeric-plus-dots/dashes/underscores identifiers at each segment.
Omitting 'parent' lists from the datastore root; set 'max-depth=0' to return only the root namespace itself (no children).
